🔥 बॉलीवुड गलियारों से आ गई है एकदम मसालेदार खबर, जिसे जानकर चौंक जाएंगे आप!

संगीतकार Anirudh Ravichander और Kavya Maran की शादी की इनसाइड तस्वीरें सोशल मीडिया पर छा गई हैं।

रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, Anirudh Ravichander ने ग्रीस में हुई अपनी इस शादी को 'फेवरेट काइंड ऑफ मैजिक' बताया है।

शादी की ये इनसाइड पिक्स फैंस के बीच तेजी से वायरल हो रही हैं और हर तरफ इसी की चर्चा है।

तो आपको Anirudh और Kavya की ये जोड़ी कैसी लगी, कमेंट करके जल्दी से बताओ!

#AnirudhRavichander #KavyaMaran #CineChaska #BollywoodNews #CelebrityWedding #InsidePictures

ctx.title: Inside PICS of Anirudh Ravichander and Kavya Maran’s Wedding: Composer calls Greece nuptials ‘favourite kind of magic’
ctx.summary:
Anirudh Ravichander and entrepreneur Kavya Maran tied the knot on November 11, 2026. As the couple exchanged vows in a destination wedding in Greece, the composer shared some special moments from the occasion, celebrating their union. 
 Inside Anirudh Ravichander and Kavya Maran’s Wedding 
 Taking to his social media handle,  Anirudh Ravichander  shared a few snapshots from his wedding day. The pictures featured the composer embracing Kavya Maran, with both sporting radiant smiles. They also offered glimpses of their families coming together to celebrate the couple's union. 
 See the pictures here: 
   One of the pictures featured Rajinikanth and his family as Anirudh and Kavya walked down the aisle. Another snapshot showed the musician singing for his wife onstage, making for a heartwarming moment. 
 Anirudh Ravichander and Sunrisers Hyderabad owner Kavya Maran recently tied the knot in a self-respect marriage ceremony, opting for a simple celebration instead of traditional wedding rituals. The couple exchanged pendants as part of the ceremony. 
 For those unfamiliar with  Kavya Maran , she is the daughter of Sun Group chairman Kalanithi Maran. She is widely known for her candid appearances at IPL matches, which frequently go viral on social media. 
 According to reports, Anirudh and Kavya exchanged rings on November 10, before tying the knot the following day. Following their intimate wedding ceremony, the newlyweds are set to host a reception at a luxurious hotel on Novemb
